'''Maria Kawamura''' (Japanese: '''川村万梨阿''' ''Kawamura Maria'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Kawamura was born as '''Shigeyo Kawamura''' ('''川村繁代''' ''Kawamura Shigeyo'') on November 21, 1961, in {{wp|Setagaya}}, {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. Kawamura has had various roles throughout {{aniseries|PTS}}, including the voice of [[Elite Four]] member [[Lorelei]] (Prima). Her most recent role was that of [[Fennel]] during {{aniseries|BW}}. She was once affiliated with {{wp|Arts Vision}}, but is now freelancing. She married manga artist {{wp|Mamoru Nagano}} on November 8, 1991.
